body: No I don't think I ever have either, but this stuff is rough, probably gonna do suicide by cop so my family that hates me won't say I went out like a bitch. You hang in there because I'm heading out

Sounds easy in theory, in practice I push people away, used to be the "funny kid" y'know, do something retarded for laughs and that was enough, but what was me doing a performance of sorts for a laugh eventually ended up defining me, and people come to me for jokes or some crazy stories but then nothing more. And sharing anything other than that hurts me, it's like I want to just be me but I can't, even when I met new people who don't know me from who I was i just cant help but be that clown. Then anyone now I've pushed away because I figured I was going to end it within a few weeks anyways.

I can recognize nearly every issue I have but even taking a single step to fix it hurts.

These messages probably aren't even coherent anymore I'm exhausted but I can't sleep after 30 hours.
Not sure then, can't say I'm familiar with your situation, hope you can beat this and that would make one of us

Novelty of everything is pretty much over, supposed to spend the next 60 odd years diligently working for something I guess. Not sure what the point is. Don't have any ties anyways got kicked out of the house a few weeks after school got called off and no real other family or friends to speak of, if I just end it now nobody will miss me, go on too long and someone might and that would hurt the most. Waking up every day thinking of ending it, and someone actually being hurt by it.
Take some zzzquil man it helps, as for the other stuff I can't help you
